name: nabsun
description: A browser for AI: Chromium as an execution environment for agents, with a bundled local model and pluggable backends (Claude, Codex/OpenAI, Ollama).
author: Naveen Alavilli

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run verify:payload && npm run verify:cli && npm run verify:connections && npm run verify:review && npm run verify:updates && npm run verify:browse && npm run verify:page && npm run verify:agent && npm run verify:mcp && npm run verify:delegation && npm run verify:local && npm run verify:bench && npm run verify:input && npm run verify:frames && npm run verify:files && npm run verify:local-files && npm run verify:office && npm run verify:voice && npm run verify:workflows && npm run verify:approvals && npm run verify:audit && npm run verify:permissions && npm run verify:network && npm run verify:integrations
scripts.verify:review: node scripts/electron-run.mjs dist/test/review-harness.js && node scripts/electron-run.mjs scripts/verify-permissions-ui.cjs && npm run verify:assistant
scripts.dist: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:win:ci: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.ci.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --linux
scripts.verify:connections: node dist/test/connection-harness.js && node scripts/electron-run.mjs scripts/verify-connections-ui.cjs && npm run verify:onboarding
scripts.verify:network: node scripts/electron-run.mjs dist/test/network-auth-harness.js && node scripts/electron-run.mjs dist/test/network-config-harness.js
